name: EMA 50/200 cross
idea: Long when EMA50 is above EMA200, short when below (classic slow trend).

name: EMA 30/120 cross with ATR buffer
idea: EMA cross that only flips once the EMA gap exceeds a fraction of ATR, to skip whipsaw crosses.

name: SMA 300 with ATR hysteresis
idea: Long once price closes an ATR band above the 50-day SMA, out when it closes back below the SMA; mirrored short.

name: Triple EMA alignment
idea: Long only when EMA20 > EMA60 > EMA180 (all horizons aligned), short when fully inverted, otherwise flat.

name: Dual SMA side 50d/100d
idea: Long only when price is above both the 50-day and 100-day SMAs, short when below both, flat in between.

name: Linear-regression slope
idea: Sign of the least-squares slope of log price over 40 days: long when rising, short when falling.

name: Supertrend
idea: ATR Supertrend stop-and-reverse with a wide multiplier.

name: Ichimoku cloud (daily-scaled)
idea: Ichimoku scaled x6 to 4h bars: long above the cloud with Tenkan > Kijun, short below with Tenkan < Kijun.

name: Donchian midline trend
idea: Long when price is in the upper part of its 40-day high-low range, short in the lower part, with a dead zone.

name: SMA ribbon vote
idea: Price versus six SMAs (50..400 bars): long when at least two thirds are below price, short when two thirds are above.

name: EMA 200 slope and side
idea: Long when EMA200 is rising and price is above it, short when falling and price is below, flat when they disagree.

name: Hull MA slope
idea: Direction of an 80-day Hull moving average (low-lag, so it needs a long window to avoid whipsaw).

name: Chandelier trend
idea: Enter on a 20-day closing high/low, exit on a 4-ATR trailing stop from the best close since entry.

name: Directional movement (DI) trend
idea: Long when Wilder +DI(84) is above -DI(84), short when below (two-week directional pressure).

name: Long-only golden regime
idea: Long only while EMA50 > EMA200 and price is above EMA50; flat otherwise (never short).

name: Two-speed EMA consensus
idea: Trade only when a fast (20/100) and a slow (50/200) EMA system agree; flat when they disagree.

name: Time-series momentum 30d
idea: Sign of the 30-day (180-bar) return.

name: Time-series momentum 60d
idea: Sign of the 60-day (360-bar) return.

name: Momentum majority vote 15/30/60d
idea: Majority vote of the signs of the 15-, 30- and 60-day returns.

name: Momentum vote 30/60/90/120d
idea: Signs of the 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-month returns vote: long on a majority up, short on a majority down, flat on a 2-2 tie.

name: Vol-scaled momentum with threshold
idea: 30-day return in units of its own volatility: enter beyond +/-0.5 sigma, exit when it crosses zero.

name: Slow MACD zero-line
idea: MACD line (EMA72 - EMA156) above zero long, below zero short.

name: MACD line and histogram agreement
idea: Long only when the 48/104 MACD line is positive and above its signal line; short on the mirror; else flat.

name: Smoothed rate of change
idea: EMA-smoothed 20-day rate of change: long when positive, short when negative.

name: Skip-recent momentum
idea: 60-day momentum that ignores the latest 5 days (classic skip-period momentum), to avoid short-term reversal noise.

name: Long-window RSI regime
idea: RSI(84) as a momentum gauge: long above 55, short below 45, exit on a cross of 50.

name: True Strength Index
idea: Double-smoothed momentum (TSI) above/below zero.

name: Volume-weighted momentum
idea: Sign of the volume-weighted average bar return over 30 days (moves on heavy volume count more).

name: On-balance volume trend
idea: OBV above its 400-bar average long, below short (volume-flow momentum).

name: Dual-horizon momentum agreement
idea: Long only when both the 30-day and 90-day returns are positive, short when both negative, else flat.

name: Aroon oscillator
idea: Aroon(150): long when the most recent 25-day high is much fresher than the most recent low, short on the mirror.

name: Range-position momentum
idea: Smoothed position of price inside its 50-day range (slow stochastic): long above 60%, short below 40%, exit at 50%.

name: Donchian 20d/10d
idea: Enter on a 20-day (120-bar) high/low breakout, exit on the opposite 10-day extreme.

name: Donchian 40/20 bars
idea: Faster channel: enter on a 40-bar breakout, exit on the opposite 20-bar extreme.

name: Trend-filtered fast Donchian
idea: 20-bar breakouts taken only in the direction of the 50-day SMA; exit on the opposite 10-bar extreme.

name: Keltner breakout 100/3
idea: Enter when price closes 3 ATR beyond EMA100, exit when it returns to the EMA.

name: Keltner breakout 20/2
idea: Fast ATR channel: enter 2 ATR beyond EMA20, exit back at the EMA.

name: Keltner breakout 50/2
idea: Medium ATR channel: enter 2 ATR beyond EMA50, exit back at the EMA.

name: Bollinger breakout with 60d momentum
idea: Close outside the 2-sigma band of SMA100 (strength, not reversal), held to the SMA, kept only when it agrees with the 60-day return.

name: Closing-high breakout with ATR trail
idea: Enter on a 15-day closing high (only above SMA300) or closing low (only below it); exit on a 3.5-ATR trailing stop.

name: Volume-confirmed breakout
idea: 10-day channel breakout in the direction of the 30/60/90-day momentum vote, on a bar with well-above-average volume; exit on the 5-day opposite extreme.

name: Keltner 20/2 in voted trend
idea: Fast ATR-channel breakouts (2 ATR beyond EMA20, exit at the EMA) taken only in the direction of the 30/60/90-day momentum vote.

name: Previous-week range breakout
idea: Close above last calendar week's high (long) or below its low (short), exit at last week's midpoint; kept only with the 30/60/90-day momentum vote.

name: Previous-month range breakout
idea: Long on a close above last calendar month's high, short below its low; exit at last month's midpoint.

name: Dual-channel breakout
idea: 10-day breakouts taken only on the correct side of the 40-day channel midline; exit on the 5-day opposite extreme.

name: Swing-pivot breakout
idea: Close above the last confirmed swing high (pivot with ~3 days each side) is long, below the last swing low is short; kept only with the 60-day return.

name: Daily-close 30d/15d breakout
idea: Turtle-style rule on daily closes only (the 20:00 UTC bar): enter on a 30-day closing high/low, exit on the 15-day opposite.

name: Rolling-VWAP band breakout
idea: Enter when price closes 2 sigma beyond the 20-day volume-weighted average price; exit back at the VWAP.

name: RSI(4) pullback in voted trend
idea: With the 15/30/60-day momentum vote up, buy RSI(4) < 25 and exit at RSI > 60 or when the trend vote flips; mirrored short.

name: Stop-run reclaim in slow trend
idea: With the 30/60/90-day vote up, a bar that undercuts the prior 5-day low but closes back above it is bought for 4 days; mirrored short.

name: Bollinger pullback in trend
idea: In a 30-day uptrend buy a close 1.5 sigma below SMA30, exit at the SMA; mirrored short.

name: Pullback-resumption entry
idea: In a voted uptrend, after at least 6 bars below EMA50 buy the first close back above it and hold until price closes below it again; mirrored short.

name: Williams %R pullback in trend
idea: With price above SMA300, buy when %R(20) drops below -90 and exit above -40 or on trend loss; mirrored short.

name: Failed-breakdown reclaim
idea: In an uptrend, a bar that pierces the prior 20-bar low but closes back above it (stop-run) is bought for 4 days; mirrored short.

name: EMA-zone pullback
idea: In an EMA50>EMA200 uptrend buy a dip of 1 ATR below EMA50, exit 1 ATR above it or on trend loss; mirrored short.

name: Bull-regime deep dip (long-only)
idea: Above the 100-day SMA, buy a close 2 sigma below SMA50 and exit back at SMA50; never short.

name: VWAP pullback in voted trend
idea: With the momentum vote up, buy when price closes 1 ATR below the 7-day rolling VWAP and exit back at the VWAP or on a vote flip; mirrored short.

name: Trend-channel lower-half entry
idea: In a 30-day uptrend buy only when price sits in the lower third of its 5-day range, exit in the upper third; mirrored short.

name: Shock continuation
idea: A 12-hour move larger than 3 sigma (of recent bar volatility) is followed in its direction for 2 days.

name: Momentum vote with volatility ceiling
idea: Momentum vote (15/30/60d) traded only while 7-day realised vol is below 1.5x its 90-day level; flat in vol spikes.

name: Bollinger squeeze breakout
idea: After band width falls into the bottom quartile of the last 40 days, trade the next 40-bar breakout in the direction of the momentum vote; exit at the SMA.

name: ATR-contraction breakout
idea: When short-term ATR has dropped below 80% of long-term ATR, trade the next 40-bar breakout; exit on the 20-bar opposite extreme.

name: Uptrend with high-vol kill switch (long-only)
idea: Long above SMA300 except when 7-day realised vol is in the top decile of the last 90 days; never short.

name: Volatility stop-and-reverse
idea: Flip when price closes more than 6 ATR(84) against the best close since the last flip; a side is held only while the 1-4 month momentum vote agrees.

name: Expanding-bandwidth trend
idea: Trade the side of SMA60 only while band width is above its 20-day average (volatility expanding) and the 60-day return agrees; else flat.

name: Up/down semivariance ratio
idea: Compare 30-day upside and downside realised variance: long when upside dominates, short when downside dominates.

name: Volatility-adaptive Donchian
idea: Channel breakout whose lookback stretches when short-term vol is high and shrinks when calm; a side is held only on the matching side of SMA300.

name: Calm uptrend (long-only)
idea: Long only when price is above SMA300 and 7-day realised vol is below its 90-day median (quiet grind higher); never short.

name: Expansion-confirmed breakout
idea: A 40-bar breakout is taken only if short-term ATR is already above long-term ATR (range expansion); exit on the 20-bar opposite extreme.

name: Volatility-normalised momentum
idea: 30-day sum of bar returns each divided by the prevailing 7-day volatility, so calm-period moves count as much as wild ones; trade its sign.

name: Trend-aligned shock
idea: A 1-day move beyond 2.5 sigma is followed for 3 days, but only when it agrees with the 30-day trend.

name: Volatility-regime speed switch
idea: Use a slow 30d/15d channel when realised vol is above its 90-day norm and a fast 40/20-bar channel when it is below.

name: ADX-gated momentum vote
idea: 30/60/90-day momentum vote, traded only while ADX(14) > 20 (a trend is actually present); flat otherwise.

name: ADX-gated EMA cross
idea: EMA 50/200 direction, traded only while ADX(14) > 20.

name: Bull/bear-aligned momentum
idea: 30-day momentum, but longs only above the 100-day SMA and shorts only below it.

name: Efficiency-ratio regime
idea: Kaufman efficiency ratio over 20 days: when the path is efficient (> 0.15) follow its direction, otherwise stay flat.

name: Choppiness-index regime
idea: Choppiness index(84) below 50 marks a trending market: follow the 14-day return; flat when choppy.

name: Regime-sided breakouts
idea: Rising 100-day SMA: only long 10-day breakouts. Falling: only short breakdowns. Exit on the 5-day opposite extreme.

name: Trend-quality (R-squared) regime
idea: Follow the 30-day regression slope only when the fit is clean (R-squared > 0.4); flat in noisy markets.

name: Volume-participation regime
idea: Momentum vote traded only while 7-day average volume is above its 90-day average (moves backed by participation).

name: Autocorrelation regime
idea: Trade the momentum vote only while daily returns are positively autocorrelated over the last 60 days (trending regime).

name: Three-timeframe agreement
idea: Weekly (42-bar) and monthly (180-bar) returns and the 100-day SMA side must all agree; otherwise flat.

name: Variance-ratio regime
idea: When the 2-day/4-hour variance ratio over 60 days is above 1 (returns trend rather than revert) follow 30-day momentum; else flat.

name: Market-structure regime
idea: Higher high and higher low versus the previous 15-day block: long. Lower high and lower low: short. Mixed: flat.

name: Extension-capped trend
idea: Momentum vote, but stand aside when price is stretched more than 8 ATR from SMA300 (late, crowded trend).

name: Asymmetric-evidence momentum
idea: Long on a simple majority of the 30/60/90-day returns, but short only when all three are negative (shorts need stronger evidence).

name: Three-system majority
idea: Majority of three different trend definitions: EMA 50/200, 30-day momentum and the Donchian 20d/10d state.

name: Trend with pullback-or-breakout entries
idea: In a voted uptrend enter on either an RSI(4) dip or a 40-bar breakout; exit on a 40-bar low or trend flip; mirrored short.

name: SMA side plus MACD timing
idea: Long when price is above SMA300 and the 24/52 MACD line is positive; short on the mirror; flat when they disagree.

name: Keltner breakout with 60d momentum
idea: Keltner 50/2 breakout state, kept only when it agrees with the sign of the 60-day return.

name: Momentum vote with OBV confirmation
idea: 30/60/90-day momentum vote, kept only when on-balance volume is on the same side of its 400-bar average.

name: Momentum vote with vol-rank kill switch
idea: Momentum vote, flat whenever 7-day realised vol is in the top decile of the last 90 days.

name: Six-horizon momentum score with hysteresis
idea: Net count of six return horizons (10 to 80 days): enter at a 4-to-2 majority, hold until the score crosses zero.

name: Momentum vote with adverse-shock pause
idea: Momentum vote, but step aside for 2 days after a 12-hour move of more than 3 sigma against the position.

name: Five-signal cross-family vote
idea: EMA cross, 30d momentum, Donchian state, OBV trend and Keltner state: trade when at least four of five agree.

name: Pullback entry with trailing exit
idea: In a voted uptrend buy an RSI(14) < 45 dip and ride it with a 4-ATR trailing stop; mirrored short.

name: Strict confluence
idea: Momentum vote, SMA300 side and ADX(14) > 15 must all line up; flat otherwise.

name: Breakout plus momentum plus volume
idea: 40-bar breakout in the direction of 30-day momentum on above-average volume; exit on the 20-bar opposite extreme or a momentum flip.

name: Slow EMA with fast Keltner agreement
idea: Position only when the EMA 50/200 direction and the fast Keltner 20/2 breakout state point the same way.

name: Seven-signal diversified average
idea: Average of seven trend/momentum/breakout/volume signals; long above +0.3, short below -0.3, flat in between.
